title: Team statement that limestone absorbs the signal from the known Khafre chambers

tellings.quote: This is because the structures are embedded in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal.

plain: In 2025 a research team that says it found hidden structures beneath the Khafre pyramid at Giza explained, in a statement on a Facebook page, why its radar scan did not clearly show the pyramid's known chambers: "the structures are embedded in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal." A researcher named Jeffrey Drum reads this statement to Michels and credits it to the team, naming Filippo Biondi and a colleague given only as Armando. Read as a document, the statement gives the team's reason for the missing signal in plain words. It does not say how the team tested that explanation, which leaves the question open.
